items.example: Thanks, that was really constructive feedback.
items.exampleTr: Teşekkürler, gerçekten yapıcı bir geri bildirimdi.
items.simple: Helping to make something better, not just saying it is bad.

items.tr: kılı kırk yarmak, ufak şeylere takılmak
items.example: I don't want to nitpick, but there's a typo on page two.
items.exampleTr: Kılı kırk yarmak istemem ama ikinci sayfada bir yazım hatası var.
items.simple: To talk about tiny, unimportant mistakes.

items.example: She's very blunt, so don't take it personally.
items.exampleTr: Çok açık sözlü, o yüzden kendine alma.
items.simple: Saying what you think in a very straight way, even if it hurts.

items.example: Isn't that a bit harsh? He did try.
items.exampleTr: Bu biraz sert değil mi? Denedi sonuçta.
items.simple: Too strong and not kind when you say something bad about someone.

items.example: The review was absolutely scathing.
items.exampleTr: Eleştiri tam anlamıyla yerden yere vuruyordu.
items.simple: Very, very unkind words about someone or something.

items.example: The idea is good, but the plan is flawed.
items.exampleTr: Fikir iyi ama plan kusurlu.
items.simple: Having a problem or mistake inside, so it does not work well.

items.example: That was a backhanded compliment if I ever heard one.
items.exampleTr: Bu duyduğum en iki anlamlı iltifattı.
items.simple: Sounds nice, but there is also a little unkind meaning hidden inside.

items.example: She deserves a lot of praise for finishing early.
items.exampleTr: Erken bitirdiği için çok övgüyü hak ediyor.
items.simple: Kind words you say when someone has done something really well.

items.example: I take your point, but I still disagree.
items.exampleTr: Ne dediğini anlıyorum ama yine de katılmıyorum.
items.simple: You say you understand what the other person means, even if you do not fully agree.

items.example: It's good, but there's room for improvement.
items.exampleTr: İyi ama geliştirilecek yönler var.
items.simple: It is okay now, but it can still be made better.

items.example: No offence, but that colour really doesn't suit you.
items.exampleTr: Kusura bakma ama o renk sana hiç yakışmamış.
items.simple: You say this before something that may hurt, so the person is not upset.

items.en: take it with a pinch of salt
items.example: Take his advice with a pinch of salt.
items.exampleTr: Onun tavsiyesini çok ciddiye alma.
items.simple: Do not believe everything. Think about it carefully first.

items.example: Don't take it personally, he criticises everyone.
items.exampleTr: Kendine alma, herkesi eleştirir.
items.simple: It is not about you. The person is not angry with you.

items.example: To be brutally honest, the first half was boring.
items.exampleTr: Acımasızca dürüst olmak gerekirse ilk yarı sıkıcıydı.
items.simple: You are going to say the true thing, even though it is not nice.

items.example: Read between the lines: she's not happy.
items.exampleTr: Satır aralarını oku: mutlu değil.
items.simple: Understand the hidden meaning that the person did not say out loud.

items.example: The joke totally missed the mark.
items.exampleTr: Espri tamamen hedefi ıskaladı.
items.simple: It did not do what it wanted to do. It did not work well.

items.example: I welcome constructive criticism, as long as it's polite.
items.exampleTr: Kibar olduğu sürece yapıcı eleştiriye açığım.
items.simple: Words that say what is wrong so that you can fix it.

items.example: That's sweeping criticism, and it isn't fair to everyone.
items.exampleTr: Bu toptan bir eleştiri ve herkese haksızlık.
items.simple: Saying everything is bad, with no small details.

items.example: The restaurant got a glowing review in the paper.
items.exampleTr: Restoran gazetede çok olumlu bir eleştiri aldı.
items.simple: A review that says very, very good things.

items.example: That's a fair point. I hadn't thought of that.
items.exampleTr: Haklı bir nokta. Bunu düşünmemiştim.
items.simple: Something someone says that is true and sensible.

items.example: That's valid criticism, and we should listen.
items.exampleTr: Bu haklı bir eleştiri, dinlemeliyiz.
items.simple: Bad words about something that are true and make sense.

items.tr: olduğundan güzel göstermek, tatlı dille anlatmak
items.example: I won't sugar-coat it: the results are bad.
items.exampleTr: Tatlı dille anlatmayacağım: sonuçlar kötü.
items.simple: To make bad news sound nicer than it really is.

items.example: She always picks holes in my ideas.
items.exampleTr: Benim fikirlerimde hep kusur bulur.
items.simple: To look hard for small mistakes in what someone said or did.

items.tr: didik didik eleştirmek, param parça etmek
items.example: They pulled my report apart in the meeting.
items.exampleTr: Toplantıda raporumu parça parça ettiler.
items.simple: To say many bad things about something, piece by piece.

items.en: I hate to say it, but it needs work.
items.tr: Söylemekten nefret ediyorum ama üzerinde çalışılması lazım.
items.example: I hate to say it, but it needs work.
items.exampleTr: Söylemekten nefret ediyorum ama üzerinde çalışılması lazım.
items.simple: You say this to give bad news in a softer, kinder way.

items.en: It's not bad, but I've seen better.
items.tr: Fena değil ama daha iyilerini gördüm.
items.example: It's not bad, but I've seen better.
items.exampleTr: Fena değil ama daha iyilerini gördüm.
items.simple: You say it is okay, but you know other things that are better.
